summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 7+ new features: Leads bug fix (Convert to Client & Create Ticket), O365 One-Click Mailbox Setup, Email-to-Lead creation, Asset Lifecycle Management, Predictive Maintenance AI, Real-time Event Bus with ticket viewers, and Client Health & Opportunity Radar. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). Fixed route ordering issue for /api/tickets/active-viewers endpoint. UI testing confirmed all new pages work correctly with proper navigation.

fixed.issue: Route was being matched by /api/tickets/{ticket_id} due to path ordering. Fixed by adding active-viewers route to tickets.py before {ticket_id} route

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in FastAPI matters - static paths must be defined before dynamic {id} paths. This was fixed by adding _ticket_viewers import and active-viewers route to tickets.py
updated_files: /app/backend/app/routers/tickets.py - Added /tickets/active-viewers route before {ticket_id} route to fix path matching

leads_bug_fix.details: Convert to Client & Create Ticket button visible and functional in lead detail view

o365_setup.details: Page shows connected status, Email-to-Lead settings toggles, and email-generated leads list. MOCKED - stores credentials for later Azure AD integration

email_to_lead.details: Webhook /api/o365/webhook/incoming-email creates leads from email data. Duplicate emails add activity to existing leads

asset_lifecycle.details: Dashboard shows lifecycle stages (Procurement, Deployment, Active, Maintenance, Decommission, Disposed) with asset counts and total value. Add Asset button works

predictive_maintenance.details: Shows device risk assessment with risk scores, failure windows, and recommendations. 11 devices analyzed with Low risk

event_bus_ticket_viewers.details: POST /api/events/publish works, GET /api/tickets/active-viewers works after route fix

health_radar.details: Shows 13 clients with health scores, 1 at-risk, 12 healthy, $6,465 potential MRR. Three tabs: At Risk, Opportunities, Healthy

ticket_numbers.details: Tickets show INC-xxxx, SR-xxxx, CHG-xxxx format badges in list view. Dashboard SLA countdown shows ticket numbers

sidebar_navigation.details: New nav items visible: Asset Lifecycle, Predictive AI, O365 Mailbox, Health Radar

mocked_apis.O365_Microsoft_Graph: Stores credentials but actual Graph API calls mocked for testing

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed assets and leads during backend testing for lifecycle and email-to-lead features
